_readme: The roster: who is in the city. One hex per property, clustered into
neighbourhoods by regional leader. Edit, restart, and the map changes.
WHAT EACH KPI MEASURES AND WHERE IT STANDS lives in config/kpis.json, not
here. One file assigns parcel addresses so the two can never disagree.
This tracked copy is a neutral template. Real property names and regional
names are business data: they belong in data/portfolio.local.json, which is
gitignored and overrides this file. `node scripts/import-financials.mjs`

townCentre.name: Town Centre
_readme: Ten blank hexes held in the middle, where the neighbourhoods converge.
Reserved for items that belong to nobody in particular — the SOP library,
email oversight, the Power Automate flow checker. Nothing is built here
yet, and the ground is held so that adding one later moves nothing.
